reviewers.summary: The delivery policy and tests cover the stated eligibility, replay, conflict, and atomicity cases. The fingerprint encoding can treat distinct envelopes as identical, violating the changed-envelope rejection criterion.

findingList.message: The delimiter-based fingerprint is ambiguous when field values contain U+001F, so changed envelopes can bypass the required same-ID conflict check.

evidence.codePathTraced: Fingerprint joins envelope fields with U+001F, and Submit returns Replayed when an existing event ID has the same fingerprint.
evidence.failureScenario: After submitting an envelope with Component="Engine" and SerialNumber="ENG-123\u001fX", resubmit the same EventId with Component="Engine\u001fENG-123" and SerialNumber="X". The joined fingerprint is unchanged, but the rendered body differs; Submit returns the original receipt as Replayed instead of rejecting the changed envelope with 409.

reviewers.summary: The tests cover the listed delivery outcomes, replay, concurrency, and injected commit failure. However, the fingerprint can collide for distinct envelopes, violating the required changed-envelope conflict behavior.

findingList.message: The delimiter-based fingerprint is ambiguous when envelope fields contain U+001F. Use an unambiguous encoding so changed envelopes under the same event ID are rejected.

evidence.codePathTraced: Submit fingerprints the envelope with string.Join using U+001F, then treats a matching fingerprint for an existing EventId as an exact replay.
evidence.failureScenario: After delivering an envelope with CaseId "case-1" and ReportId "rep-1", submit the same EventId with CaseId "case-1\u001frep-1" and an empty ReportId. The joined fields produce the same fingerprint, so Submit returns the original receipt with status 200 instead of rejecting the changed envelope with 409.

reviewers.summary: The delimiter-based envelope fingerprint allows distinct envelopes to collide, violating M-04's requirement to reject changed envelopes under a reused event ID. No external-message path is present in this diff.

findingList.message: The delimiter-based fingerprint is ambiguous when field values contain U+001F. Encode fields unambiguously before hashing so changed envelopes cannot be accepted as exact replays.

evidence.codePathTraced: Submit fingerprints the envelope by joining its fields with U+001F, then treats a matching fingerprint for an existing event ID as an exact replay.
evidence.failureScenario: Submit an envelope with Component "Engine" and SerialNumber "ENG-123\u001ffoo", then reuse its EventId with Component "Engine\u001fENG-123" and SerialNumber "foo". Both envelopes produce the same joined fingerprint, but render different bodies; the second submission returns the original receipt as Replayed instead of rejecting the changed envelope with 409.
